I can't see the repository, so this is from memory of the open-source Netflix Dispatch code and I haven't checked it against your copy.

As I remember it, case types have an `auto_close` option. When a case of such a type is created, Dispatch calls `case_auto_close_flow` in the case flows module. That function sets the case's resolution to "Auto closed via case type auto close configuration." and its resolution reason to `CaseResolutionReason.user_acknowledged`, whose displayed value is "User Acknowledged". It then moves the case to the closed status.

The function name and file path are the parts I'm most sure of. I'm less sure of the exact resolution reason, so grep for `auto_close` in `dispatch/case/` to confirm.

FILE: src/dispatch/case/flows.py
FUNCTION: case_auto_close_flow
REASON: User Acknowledged (CaseResolutionReason.user_acknowledged)
